L1.BIAN: Strong: Customer Relationship Management, Party Lifecycle Management, Counterparty Risk, Customer Agreement, Customer Access Entitlement. No domain for KYC screening, client categorisation or SSIs.
L1.CALM: Services, systems and databases; client is an actor.
L1.FIX: IOI for axes; SettlementInstructions and SettlementInstructionRequest for standing instructions only; onboarding itself is not a FIX process.
L1.FpML_CDM: CDM legal agreements model for CSA elections.
L1.ISO20022: Not used here in this map (acmt applies to custody accounts in L5).
L1.other: KYC/AML and MiFID categorisation (unverified); no data standard for KYC files.

L2.BIAN: Good: Quote Management, Market Making, Suitability Checking, Product Design; Trading Models is closest fit. No domain for the single-dealer platform.
L2.CALM: Engagement services and web clients; multi-dealer platforms are ecosystem externals.
L2.FIX: QuoteRequest, Quote, QuoteResponse; NewOrderSingle through the client channel.
L2.FpML_CDM: Product model for structured and OTC trades.
L2.other: MiFID suitability, appropriateness, costs and charges (unverified).

L3.BIAN: Strong: Market Order, Market Order Execution, Program Trading, eTrading Workbench, Trader Position Operations; Commissions for fees and billing. No domain for pre-trade controls, DMA, FX aggregation, venue gateways, booking or enrichment.
L3.CALM: Systems, services, web clients and network gateways.
L3.FIX: Core: NewOrderSingle, ExecutionReport, Quote; TradeCaptureReport at booking.
L3.FpML_CDM: CDM event model at execution feeds booking and derivative reporting.
L3.ISO20022: None (setr is fund and securities trade initiation, used little on sell-side execution).

L4.BIAN: Good: Order Allocation, Trade Confirmation Matching, Trade Clearing, Credit and Margin Management, Collateral Allocation Management. No domain for portfolio reconciliation, lifecycle events, structured products lifecycle, client clearing or compression.
L4.CALM: Services and systems; matching utility and CCP are ecosystems.
L4.FIX: AllocationInstruction, AllocationReport, Confirmation, ConfirmationAck, TradeCaptureReport, PositionReport, CollateralReport, MarginRequirementReport.
L4.FpML_CDM: Core: FpML confirmation; CDM product, event, collateral and margin call models for lifecycle, structured products, margin and compression.
L4.ISO20022: secl for securities clearing only (derivative and futures clearing use FIXML, FpML or CCP-specific interfaces); colr margin calls. Confirmations not mapped (setr/fxtr exist but were not checked at message level).
L4.SWIFT_MT: MT300/305 FX confirmations and MT558 triparty (unverified).
L4.other: T+1 affirmation (verified dates) and ISDA SIMM verified; EMIR confirmation, portfolio reconciliation and clearing duties, UMR scope and CCP margin models unverified.

L5.BIAN: Good: Trade Settlement, Securities Fails Processing, Sub Custodian Agreement, Securities Position Keeping, Custody Administration, Corporate Action; Customer Tax Handling is closest fit. No domain for CSD, PvP, income or custody segregation.
L5.CALM: CSDs and PvP system are ecosystems; services and databases for settlement and custody.
L5.FIX: None mapped; SettlementInstructions is a standing instruction message and sits with SSIs in L1.
L5.SWIFT_MT: MT540-548, MT535-537, MT564-568 (unverified numbers); Swift set no securities MT end date (verified).
L5.other: EU CSDR settlement discipline, US/UK/EU T+1 and CLS verified; CASS and 15c3-3 unverified (client assets oversight sits in L7); no global standard for tax reclaim files.

L6.BIAN: Partial: Stock Lending and Repos, Credit and Margin Management, Collateral Asset Administration, Payment Execution; Corporate Treasury is closest fit. No domain for locates, TRS or rehypothecation.
L6.CALM: Systems, services and a client reporting web client.
L6.FpML_CDM: CDM securities lending, repo and eligible collateral representation; FpML/CDM equity swaps.
L6.ISO20022: colr for collateral; pacs and camt for cash and liquidity.
L6.SWIFT_MT: None mapped; cross-border payments moved to pacs/camt in November 2025 (verified).
L6.other: SFTR verified (SFTR reporting itself sits in L7); Reg SHO, Reg T, FINRA 4210 and CASS reuse unverified.

L7.BIAN: Partial: Market Risk Models, Trading Book Oversight, Financial Instrument Valuation, Limit and Exposure Management, Market Risk; Economic Capital, Regulatory Reporting, Trade and Price Reporting (public trade publication), Compliance Reporting, Regulatory Compliance. No domain for surveillance, best execution, valuation adjustments or client money.
L7.FpML_CDM: FpML reporting views; CDM event model feeds derivative reporting.
L7.ISO20022: auth for authority reporting (MiFIR, EMIR, SFTR).
L7.other: MiFIR Art 26, EMIR Refit, CFTC Part 45, SFTR and UK MAR Art 16 verified; Part 43, SBSR, UK MiFIR, SEC CAT, FINRA TRACE, best execution, CASS, FRTB, SA-CCR, CVA, Volcker, recording of communications and MAR control room duties unverified.

L8.BIAN: Good: Information Provider Operation and Administration, Market Data Switch Operation, Market Information Management, Financial Instrument Reference Data Management, Legal Entity Directory, Financial Gateway, Archive Services, Account Reconciliation; closest fit for Position Keeping, Financial Accounting, Employee Access, Continuity Planning, Contractor and Supplier Agreement. No domain for colocation, curves, lineage, event streaming, message translation, operational risk incidents or front-to-back reconciliation.
L8.CALM: Services, databases and networks; ldap for identity.
L8.FIX: MarketDataSnapshotFullRefresh and MarketDataIncrementalRefresh for market data; SecurityDefinition for instruments; PositionReport for reconciliation against CCP statements; session layer at the gateway.
L8.FpML_CDM: CDM product model for instruments; CDM event model for the trade and position store.
L8.ISO20022: reda for reference data, camt and semt for reconciliation; the gateway and translation service carry all business areas.
L8.other: PS21/3 and DORA verified; BCBS 239, record keeping and Rule 17a-4 unverified; no open standard for market data licence and usage reporting.
